failure_reproduction.observed_reason: The second caller could evaluate the issue lock after the first caller transferred it to the matching continuation, then return issue_execution_lock_changed before the transaction could deduplicate.

fix.preflight: Continues to enforce budget, agent, issue state, ownership, pause and dependency gates without treating an already-transferred lock as authoritative before deduplication.
fix.transaction: Locks the issue, finds an exact live continuation first, and otherwise enforces that the source Run still owns the issue lock before inserting.
fix.promotion: Unchanged and continues to enforce that each due retry Run owns the issue lock.

verification.command: two focused cases x five fresh runs
